upstream.description: n8n skillset for Claude Code to build flawless n8n workflows

classification.analysis: n8n-skills is a Claude Code plugin bundling 14 expert skills plus an always-on router and hook-based enforcement layer that teach Claude how to build correct n8n automation workflows using the companion n8n-mcp MCP server. It covers expression syntax, MCP tool usage, workflow patterns, validation-error interpretation, node configuration, JavaScript/Python code nodes, error handling, binary data, sub-workflows, AI agent nodes, multi-instance targeting, and end-to-end self-hosted n8n deployment (Docker Compose + Caddy). It targets developers using Claude Code/Codex to build or operate n8n workflow automations who want to avoid common MCP and node-configuration pitfalls.

use_cases.title: Have Claude Code build correct n8n workflows via the n8n-mcp server
Debug n8n validation errors and expression syntax mistakes
Design an n8n AI Agent node with tools, memory, and structured output
Deploy a production self-hosted n8n instance behind Caddy with HTTPS
